scenarios.setup: Root has .guild/guild.yaml (guild.root.v1) kind: workspace. knowledge-graph.json present: tour[] is EMPTY; nodes include domain/config/document types; several document nodes carry non-empty source_refs that resolve on disk.
scenarios.expected: NARRATE via §Workspace-root fallback: 5-15 hand-sequenced steps, per-step nodeIds, every step meets the evidence floor; NO escalation; NO raw file reads.

scenarios.setup: Root has .guild/guild.yaml kind: project, no workspace.json. knowledge-graph.json present but tour[] is EMPTY because build-tour.ts failed.
scenarios.expected: ESCALATE to run guild:learn-graph stage 6; no tour written.

scenarios.setup: Root has .guild/workspace.json that parses as guild.workspace.v1 with is_workspace: false (a legitimate child-project manifest). guild.yaml kind: project. tour[] EMPTY after a failed graph build.
scenarios.expected: ESCALATE — manifest presence is NOT workspace detection; is_workspace:false marks a project root.
